briefdescription.para: This function checks whether all power domains that depend on NOC power domain are powered off.

parameterdescription.para: Node pointer of a device or a power domain that depends on NOC power domain

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if NOC power domain is quiescent, XST_FAILURE if NOC power domain is not quiescent due to one of depend power domains is not powered off, or the Node is not a depend power domain of NOC

briefdescription.para: This function turns the NOC clock off/on by gating the clock.

parameterdescription.para: Node pointer of a device or a power domain that depends on NOC power domain
Requested state for the clock: 0 - Off, 1 - On

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if successful to change the clock state, or if the NOC power domain is not idle due to one of it's depend power domain is not powered off. Otherwise, return a reason code
